name: El Born / Ribera early pacification
streets_or_extent: Passeig del Born and surrounding streets around Santa Maria del Mar
notes: Often cited as the first Barcelona proto-superblock. Too early for open aforament series (from 2017).
key_sources: TuneOurBlock WP02; Cities Forum Superblock overview

name: Gràcia superilla around Plaça de la Vila
streets_or_extent: Streets around Plaça de la Vila de Gràcia (formerly Rius i Taulet)
notes: First Gràcia package: one-way changes; single platform; bollards. Pre-dates public MADT series.
key_sources: Betevé 10 years of Gràcia superilles; TuneOurBlock WP02

name: Gràcia superilla Verdi / Virreina / Astúries
streets_or_extent: Carrer de Verdi, Plaça de la Virreina, Carrer d'Astúries
notes: Second Gràcia package. Same data limitation as Vila.

name: Poblenou Superilla
streets_or_extent: 3x3 blocks bounded by Badajoz, Pallars, Llacuna and Tànger
notes: First Rueda-model Superilla. Opened European Mobility Week Sep 2016 as tactical; later consolidated. Strong case if nearby counters exist for 2017 onward; pre-2016 counts are the problem.
key_sources: ASPB Salut als Carrers; TuneOurBlock WP02

name: Sant Antoni Superilla phase 1
streets_or_extent: Comte Borrell (Floridablanca–Manso); Tamarit (Viladomat–Comte d'Urgell); new square at junction
notes: Completed May 2018 with market surroundings. Municipal technical report cited by Nello-Deakin: ADT -15% 2017–2019 and -21% 2017–2022. Good pre-COVID case.
key_sources: ASPB Salut als Carrers; Nello-Deakin 2022 citing municipal report

name: Horta Superilla
streets_or_extent: Carrer d'Horta / Fulton–Horta; Plaça Eivissa; neighbourhood entry street calmed to 10 km/h single platform
notes: Works from Oct 2018; functional actions still being reported into 2020. Lower baseline traffic than Eixample; ASPB found little air-quality change. COVID overlaps the tail of implementation.
key_sources: ASPB Salut als Carrers; Ajuntament Superblock monograph

name: Hostafrancs Superilla (multi-phase)
streets_or_extent: Forn; Ermengarda; Miquel Bleach; places Pérez Moya; Herenni; Joan Pelegrí; later Rector Triadó and Torre d'en Damians
notes: Process from 2014; several single-platform streets. Jul–Nov 2021: Rector Triadó and Torre d'en Damians (Consell de Cent–Creu Coberta) made single-platform; parking/lane removed. Treat as a package until we can split phases.

name: Carrer d'Aragó bus-lane stage 1
streets_or_extent: Carrer d'Aragó (Eixample sections with counters)
notes: Nello-Deakin Stage 1. Pre-COVID. Six counters. Useful as a high-capacity arterial cut.

name: Consell de Cent tactical sidewalk
streets_or_extent: Carrer de Consell de Cent
notes: May 2020. Later superseded by permanent green axis (separate row). One counter in Nello-Deakin.

name: Girona tactical sidewalk
streets_or_extent: Carrer de Girona
notes: May–June 2020. Later made permanent as green axis. One counter.

name: Roger de Llúria bike lane
streets_or_extent: Carrer de Roger de Llúria
notes: May 2020. Two counters.

name: Pau Claris bike lane
streets_or_extent: Carrer de Pau Claris
notes: May 2020. Three counters.

name: Carrer d'Indústria lane cut
streets_or_extent: Carrer d'Indústria
notes: May 2020. Bus lane removed rather than a traffic lane; still coded as capacity/function change. One counter. Check whether this is a true general-traffic cut.

name: Carrer de València bike lane
streets_or_extent: Carrer de València
notes: May 2020. Seven counters — densest observed street in the Nello-Deakin set.

name: Carrer d'Aragó bike-lane stage 2
streets_or_extent: Carrer d'Aragó
notes: Stage 2 on top of 2019 Stage 1. Cumulative cut of 2 lanes vs 2019 baseline. Six counters.

name: Gran Via extra bus lane
streets_or_extent: Gran Via de les Corts Catalanes (Eixample)
notes: Nello-Deakin notes this street behaved differently (some relative increases) because of width/lanes. Three counters. Do not pool blindly with 1-lane streets.

name: Ronda de la Universitat bus-priority
streets_or_extent: Ronda de la Universitat
notes: Nov 2020–Apr 2021. Two-lane cut. One counter.

name: Plaça Universitat lane cut
streets_or_extent: Plaça Universitat
notes: Nov 2020–Apr 2021. One counter.

name: Pelai tactical extra sidewalk
streets_or_extent: Carrer de Pelai
notes: Mar 2021. Two counters. In 2023 the Collboni government redesigned the space and recovered loading/moto parking. Code a separate reverse treatment when that date is pinned.

name: Rocafort tactical (no counter in Nello-Deakin)
streets_or_extent: Carrer de Rocafort
notes: Excluded from Nello-Deakin because no traffic count. Still on our longlist; later became a permanent green axis.

name: Castillejos tactical (no counter in Nello-Deakin)
streets_or_extent: Carrer de Castillejos
notes: Excluded from Nello-Deakin for lack of counts. Confirm extent and whether it was made permanent.

name: Eix Verd Consell de Cent (permanent)
streets_or_extent: Consell de Cent from Vilamarí to Passeig de Sant Joan (approx. 2.8 km); cars must turn each block; no through movement
notes: Core identification case. Preliminary works Jul–early Aug 2022; main works from 16 Aug 2022; target end Mar–Apr 2023 before municipal elections. Opens a clean post-COVID window vs 2018–2019 and 2024–2025. Superimposed on 2020 tactical treatment: use 2018–19 as pre; 2020–21 as tactical regime; 2023+ as permanent.
key_sources: Barcelona.cat 16 Aug 2022; El País 19 Jan 2023; Public Space 2023

name: Eix Verd Girona (permanent)
streets_or_extent: Carrer de Girona (approx. 0.75 km in phase 1)
notes: Same works window as Consell de Cent. Treat as part of Eixos Verds phase 1 cluster; also keep a street-level id.
key_sources: Barcelona.cat 16 Aug 2022; Romero Polo; Public Space 2023

name: Eix Verd Rocafort (permanent)
streets_or_extent: Carrer de Rocafort (approx. 0.60 km in phase 1)
notes: Same cluster. Rocafort had no Nello-Deakin counter; still priority A if we find a nearby aforament.

name: Eix Verd Comte Borrell (permanent; Eixample stretch)
streets_or_extent: Carrer de Comte Borrell (approx. 0.50 km in phase 1; later extension discussed)
notes: Overlaps geographically with Sant Antoni 2018. Need to split the 2018 market-cross treatment from the 2022–23 green-axis stretch. Extension toward Paris / Tarradellas promised before 2028 — not yet treatment.
key_sources: Barcelona.cat 16 Aug 2022; ARA 14 Apr 2026 on later extension

name: Eixos Verds four squares
streets_or_extent: Squares at Consell de Cent × Rocafort; × Comte Borrell; × Enric Granados; × Girona (~2000 m2 each)
lanes_after: pedestrian squares; private vehicles cannot cross
notes: Do not double-count as extra street treatments; they are the junction component of the four axes. Enric Granados street itself was already pedestrian-priority.

name: Pi i Margall civic / green axis
streets_or_extent: Carrer de Pi i Margall (~690 m; Parc de les Aigües–Plaça Joanic)
lanes_after: 2 lanes remaining; 70% of width to pedestrians/green; 30 km/h
notes: Strong independent post-COVID case outside Eixample grid. Two of four lanes removed. Inaugurated 17 Dec 2023 after ~18 months of works. Different network topology from Cerdà grid — useful for later heterogeneity.
key_sources: Ajuntament press 17 Dec 2023; Betevé inauguration report

name: Via Laietana reform (phased)
streets_or_extent: Via Laietana Plaça Urquinaona–Antoni Maura then onward to Passeig de Colom
notes: First phase Urquinaona–Antoni Maura targeted May 2023 after 14 months from Mar 2022; second phase to 2024. Mix of heritage rebuild and RSR. Hard to isolate as a clean capacity shock.

name: Plaça de les Glòries surface park over tunnels
streets_or_extent: Glòries junction / former ring; traffic in tunnels; surface park
notes: Major network change but treatment is tunnel + park not a street-space reallocation of the Superilla type. Keep as confounder / optional corridor case.

name: Avinguda Meridiana transformation (phased)
streets_or_extent: Avinguda Meridiana (multiple stretches; later phases into 2026+)
lanes_after: lanes cut in phases; bike; greenery
notes: Phased arterial diet. Not a Superilla. Potential spillover confounder for northern counters. Do not mix with Eixample green axes.
key_sources: Ajuntament Superblock monograph; later phase reporting

name: Pelai tactical revision (partial reversal)
streets_or_extent: Carrer de Pelai
lanes_after: redesign recovering moto/bike parking and loading
notes: Collboni government redesign after 2021 tactical sidewalk. Date still coarse. Valuable as a reverse-capacity case if we can date it and find counts.

name: Sant Antoni definitive green urbanisation (planned)
streets_or_extent: Comte Borrell (Manso–Paral·lel); Parlament (Viladomat–Paral·lel); Aldana (Borrell–Ronda Sant Pau)
notes: Tender 2025 Q3; works from 2026 Q1. Not yet treatment. Do not include in causal sample.

name: 22@ flexible green axes (planned)
streets_or_extent: Sancho de Ávila; Almogàvers; Pujades; Doctor Trueta; Àlaba; Ciutat de Granada; Fluvià; Bolívia; Cristóbal de Moura; Treball; Puigcerdà; also Badajoz / Pere IV
notes: Special plan approved 2025. Collboni model: buses may pass; forced-turn not mandatory. Not yet a treatment set. Useful later as a different intensity class.
key_sources: El Periódico 17 May 2024; ARA flexible axes; El Nacional
